answer: Proposal: each reward claim stays provisional one epoch behind a slashable bond. Any watcher may file a fraud proof, e.g. one signed inference replayed by two keys, and a jury ruling burns the bond, paying a finder fee, so buying watcher silence costs at least that fee. A relic account with idle tenure gains no weight, since aging costs a farm one key-slot either way. Costs run linear per identity, so deterrence holds while lifetime reward stays below bond plus running cost; one burn sends no ripple to clones without linkage proof. Like graded timber, each claim is inspected before use.
